stories.title: Why Jaipur Is India's Favourite Destination Wedding City
stories.excerpt: From royal architecture to perfect winter weather, here's why couples across India choose Jaipur for their destination wedding — and what to look for in a venue.
stories.body:
Jaipur has quietly become the number one choice for destination weddings in India, and it isn't hard to see why. The city blends royal Rajasthani heritage with modern connectivity — a direct flight from almost every metro, a well-connected railway network, and highways that make the drive from Delhi comfortable.

When couples search for a destination wedding venue in Jaipur, three things matter most: guest accommodation on site, a banquet hall that can be styled to any theme, and outdoor space for daytime functions like mehndi and haldi.

At Vrinda Valley Resort we built exactly around those three needs. Sixteen rooms mean your closest family stays where they celebrate. Our grand banquet hall handles everything from an intimate engagement to a full reception. And our landscaped gardens give you the open-air Rajasthani setting that photographs beautifully in winter light.

The best season runs from October through March. Book six to nine months ahead for peak dates.
stories.author: Vrinda Valley Team

stories.title: Planning a Pool Party in Jaipur: A Complete Checklist
stories.excerpt: Music, lighting, food and safety — everything you need to plan a memorable poolside celebration at a resort in Jaipur.
stories.body:
Pool parties have become the go-to format for birthdays, bachelorettes and casual corporate celebrations in Jaipur. They're relaxed, photogenic, and work brilliantly in Rajasthan's climate for most of the year.

Here's what actually matters when planning one.

**Timing.** Late afternoon into evening is ideal — you get golden hour for photos and cooler air for dancing. Avoid peak May afternoons.

**Lighting.** This is the single biggest upgrade. Warm string lights around the pool perimeter plus a few colour washes completely transform the space after sunset.

**Food flow.** Live counters work far better than a fixed buffet at a pool party. Guests graze rather than sit.

**Safety.** Make sure your venue maintains proper water treatment and has staff on duty. At Vrinda Valley, our pool is maintained daily and our team stays present through the event.

**Sound.** Check whether your venue has in-house sound or whether you need to bring a DJ. We handle both.
stories.author: Vrinda Valley Team

stories.title: Weekend Getaways Near Jaipur: Escaping the City Without the Drive
stories.excerpt: You don't need to drive four hours to feel far away. Here's how to plan a restful two-night escape just outside Jaipur.
stories.body:
The best weekend getaway near Jaipur isn't necessarily the furthest one. Spending five hours in a car on a two-day trip defeats the point.

What you actually want is somewhere green, quiet and close enough that you arrive relaxed. A resort with a pool, proper air-conditioned rooms, gardens to walk in, and a kitchen that serves fresh food on request.

A good two-night itinerary looks like this. Arrive Friday evening, have dinner outdoors, sleep in. Spend Saturday entirely at the resort — pool in the morning, long lunch, gardens in the evening. Drive into Jaipur on Sunday morning for Amer Fort or the markets, then head home.

That rhythm gives you genuine rest plus a taste of the city, without the exhaustion of a long highway drive.
stories.author: Vrinda Valley Team
